item.text:
`singlethreaded` builds successfully in release mode (`cargo build -p openraft --release --features singlethreaded`), so no new defect was found in that feature path.

The feature matrix now covers:

- default: 194 library tests pass.
- `storage-v2`: 194 pass.
- `compat,serde`: 196 pass.
- `compat` alone: fails to compile (F11).
- `singleterm-leader`, `loosen-follower-log-revert`, and `generic-snapshot-data`: pass with the audit suite.
- `singlethreaded`: release build passes.

The audit remains at eleven confirmed findings, led by the high-severity snapshot-install/purge crash window and including the `compat` feature-build failure, the worker-panic hangs, the zero-config liveness cases, blocking `add_learner`, `QuitLeader` replication retention, and the shutdown/state-machine-worker race. Full details and reproduction commands are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/report.md); sources, patches, and targeted logs are under [audit](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit). The generated tracing log was removed, and no production openraft logic was changed.
